description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on two facades including top facade, providing additional natural light into the living area. Kitchen at top area of open plan space, wall counter, no kitchen island. Cook faces wall, back to dining area. Living arrangement: dining top-left, kitchen top-right, seating center. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. Bathroom config: 1 full bathroom; 1 WC-only room. Parallel morning routines possible. Both bedrooms in lower private zone from corridor. No en-suite. Single bedroom large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations: (1) children's bedroom; (2) home office or hobby room; (3) guest room; (4) bunk bed. Storage room in corridor zone, suitable for coats, bikes, laundry or utility storage. Entry from bottom. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples needing a spare room, people working from home.
not_suitable_for: families with two or more children
